text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even though I thought this time would be it...
Even though I worked so hard... in training, too...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Even if it's slow, you're still moving forward.
Let's think about the day you win!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even in training, I've been running better than before,
and I'm better at running than when I ran my first
race... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, I'm okay now!
Even if it's slow, bit by bit,
I'm growing stronger!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best again starting today,
so please treat me well!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Moping around won't make me any stronger.
I have to believe I'll win someday and keep on running...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much!
Once again, I look forward to working with you starting today!
